scope_order_policy: All 20 frozen articles retained. Still-pending tasks were reprioritized by shortest remaining whole article to obtain finite complete examples; original and new order archived in run config. Completed examples are not representative accuracy or throughput samples.
limitations: This is a partial local run unless full_selection_complete is true. The denominator remains all 20 selected articles and 115 source units.
Earlier 480-second task cutoffs and interrupted CPU-contention phases are retained in history; only the new worker uses 1800 seconds and four requested/observed CPU threads.
At least one valid unit reused prior accepted decisions; do not treat cumulative or resumed timings as cold throughput.
Local 1200-character units differ from remote 4000-character units. Compare outcome counts only within their frozen profile/unit scope.
Observed source-anchor validation is a software integrity check, not independently reviewed interpretation accuracy.

The process RSS peak includes observed Ollama server/runner and benchmark/index drivers; sums can double-count shared pages and exclude browser/OS. Earlier unavailable monitoring is not reconstructed.
